text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, shall we get training started!
Pokke, Pandora, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Pandora & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
Fweeey.
Yes!

text_block_list.name: Pandora & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
Fweeyaaah~...
Deiiyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora and Jungle Pocket
run side by side.
However, the difference in motivation between them is stark...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Are you mockin' me, bastard?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Put some damn spirit into it! Why are you
always slacking off like this, over and over...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way~, but like, I feel like I was
actually keeping up pretty well with you, Pokke-senpai~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup, I worked pretty hard! Please
forgive me for today♡ Teehee-bleh☆

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You little... If you actually got serious,
you could do WAY better than that...!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Pokke. Nagging her too much
isn't going to help, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own personality. Respecting
that and leaving things to their own initiative
is "our" policy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pandora, for the next practice race,
go ahead and run however you like.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, they tried letting her run completely
on her own terms, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
6th place, huh. Well, I had my moments, so
aren't I a good girl♪ Luck will be on my side next time.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Fuji-san, isn't she completely hopeless
even when left to do her own thing?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she's quite a tricky pony-chan. So neither
the strict athletic way nor self-initiative works...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Is she made of jelly or something? What the
hell are we supposed to do with her...?
choice_data_list: How about just giving her a strategy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you let her run without a plan, she wanders
off even more. When I casually chimed in...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A strategy, huh. Good point. Even if we don't
force hard work on her, we can at least give her a plan.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pandora, ready?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, came the actual race.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Let's see~, the plan was just to stick in
second place, right? Then when the leader tires, dash!
Easy-peasy☆)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhhhh♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh☆ Aren't I amazing, this is crazy~! Won with
a skip in my step♪ Though I just did what I was told.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees, yes, yes, Fuji-senpai☆
I pulled it off perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No way... This girl... That run just now—
no joke, it was insane...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now this... was quite a surprise. Executing
a race plan to the letter is no easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well done, Pandora. Rather than leaving you to
your own devices, fitting you into a race plan
seems to suit you much better.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeees, I think so too~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waha☆ That felt like a pretty good run.
Though I just did what I was told.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees, yes, yes, Fuji-senpai☆
I didn't win, but I did pretty alright, right~?♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't screw with me! You made it that far,
so why'd you get passed right at the end, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Pokke. Let's take it as a win that
we saw some real potential.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Rather than leaving Pandora to her own devices,
fitting her into a concrete race plan might yield
much better results.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeees, I think so too~♡
